functions.matches:
def matches(result, wanted):
    output = result["stdout"] + result["stderr"]
    return (valid_step(result) and type(result["exit_code"]) is int and result["exit_code"] == wanted["exit_code"]
            and all(s in output for s in wanted["contains"])
            and not any(s in output for s in wanted.get("excludes", [])))
functions.expectation:
def expectation(value, *, red):
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "check expectation must be an object")
    code = value.get("exit_code")
    require(type(code) is int and (1 <= code <= 125 if red else code == 0), "invalid expected check exit")
    for key in ("contains", "excludes"):
        items = value.get(key, [])
        require(isinstance(items, list) and all(isinstance(s, str) and s for s in items),
                "output predicates must be lists of nonempty literal strings")
    require(bool(value.get("contains")), "require named assertion/progress evidence")
